> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **221** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **6** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 482e089a14bb1ca5a5abccb5ea8bb13f27b28db8` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `fe0852dd6d67ad0d7243ac96f3e531e272e792f0` — the merge of head `91247933f40d2cef2a8ec0118eed28ba2c19dd25` into base `482e089a14bb1ca5a5abccb5ea8bb13f27b28db8`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin fe0852dd6d67ad0d7243ac96f3e531e272e792f0 && git checkout fe0852dd6d67ad0d7243ac96f3e531e272e792f0
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 482e089a14bb1ca5a5abccb5ea8bb13f27b28db8 91247933f40d2cef2a8ec0118eed28ba2c19dd25 && git checkout -B drift-repro 482e089a14bb1ca5a5abccb5ea8bb13f27b28db8 && git merge --no-ff 91247933f40d2cef2a8ec0118eed28ba2c19dd25

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 482e089a14bb1ca5a5abccb5ea8bb13f27b28db8
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 482e089a14bb1ca5a5abccb5ea8bb13f27b28db8` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 通知相关对象（收件箱消息、通知回执、投递、偏好、模板、HTTP 投递、用户设备）和摘要标题「您有 N 条通知」补齐繁體中文、阿拉伯语、法语、巴西葡语 4 种语言；俄语、德语、韩语在下半张 PR。原有 4 种不动。
- **为什么改：** 平台语言表定了 11 种语言（#29428 裁定 F），#30512 按包补齐，这是第 5 个包的上半（该包超 3000 行，按语言拆两半）。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加翻译和注册行。行为变化：法语读者（fr-FR）的通知与摘要标题从英文变为法文；表外语言照旧回落。阿拉伯语标题写成计数式（「通知数：N」），因为 t() 不选复数形式。回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/services/service-messaging/src/translations/messages.ts`（4 句标题与复数说明），再看 `index.ts` 注册行。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging test`。
- **需要您做的：** 无，席位经合并队列落地（非受管面，2195 行，非 BREAKING）。
- **席位意见：** ACCEPT。抽查法语对象包与 4 句标题，术语与已有三种一致；三处测试改动都是前提移动（fr 现在有包，「无包语言」改用 it-IT），断言逐字不变，另加 fr-FR 读 fr 包的用例，不是放宽。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:server#2 · head `91247933f40d2cef2a8ec0118eed28ba2c19dd25`

- **形态:** draft, author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay `pr_create`), no assignee, no review request; 15 files, +2178 −17; `check-governed-merges --pr 30638`: NOT governed, 2195 lines ≤ 3000. Title has no `!`. `Refs #30512` (package 5 of 11, half A; the card stays open).
- **Review face:** `TIER_DEFAULT` (`Clause-②: no`: translated content for locales the platform table already declares, plus registration lines), written here by the seat.
- **Seat rulings held:** oversize package split by locale into halves ≤ 3000 lines (A: `zh-Hant`/`ar`/`fr`/`pt-BR`; B: `ru`/`de`/`ko`); table tags for the new files; existing `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES` untouched; no stale-fill baseline entry.
- **Seat read:** `index.ts` registers the four bundles through `withSourceFallback` with their source hashes and messages; `scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` lists the tags. `messages.ts`: the `MessagingLocale` union widens with the four tags; each heading keeps `{{count}}`; the Arabic heading is a count-neutral tally, and the docblock now says why. Two vocabulary/empty-state pins (`admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts`, `setup-list-empty-states.test.ts`) now also read the four new bundles: wider coverage, not looser. Spot check `fr` (Message de la boîte de réception / Auteur de l'action): consistent; `sys_notification.actor_id` and FK arrows kept as written.
- **Test change:** `keyed-notification-text.integration.test.ts`: the no-pack recipient moves from `fr-FR` to `it-IT` (same assertions, Italian is outside the platform table); a new case pins `fr-FR` reading the `fr` pack. A moved premise, not a loosening.
- **Note for half B:** Russian also varies above two (2–4 vs 5+), so the `ru` heading must be count-neutral like `ar`, and the docblock names it too.
- **Dev readings (`91247933`):** package tests 845 (66 files) pass, typecheck, `check:i18n` in sync; derived gates 62, all exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED. Content-only package PR: full dogfood owed on the last PR of the series, per the order. os-dev-report 6667559214.
- **门禁 check-runs:** in progress at ACCEPT; the seat queues once every check is green or an expected skip.
- **落地条款:** Refs #30512. Ordinary queue landing by this seat: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` on this head; the card ticks `service-messaging` only after half B merges.
